---
name: Implementation defect or contract gap
about: Report incorrect behavior, missing boundary coverage or inconsistent documentation
---

## Affected contract and revision

Name the packet, invariant, profile and exact revision.

## Minimal reproduction

Provide a bounded synthetic reproduction with no live credentials or personal records.

## Expected and actual behavior

Include reason codes, event identities and whether any actual external effect occurred.

## Scope

Is this a reference-model defect, plan contradiction, adapter bug or scientific failure? Do not infer production safety from reference behavior.
